title: Bharat mein pariksha leak ne Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat ko ujagar kiya
description: Bharat mein ek pariksha leak ne Gen Z ke liye naukri sankat ko ujagar kiya hai, jo ki bahut gahra hai. Is leak ke kaaran kayi yuvaon ki naukri ki ummeeden toot gayi hain. Iska impact bharatiya arthvyavastha par bhi padega.
